# ASCII tab fixtures

Every file in this folder was **written by the Riffway authors for the unit tests** (TASKS.md D2).
None is copied or adapted from Ultimate Guitar, ClassTab or any other tab site; the riffs are
generic exercises (open-string power chords, arpeggios, scale fragments).

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `ug-style-riff.txt` | UG-style mess: `Artist:`/`Song:`/`Tuning: Drop D` header, chord-name lines, `PM----` spans, `[Section]` headings, a lyric line, `x2` repeat suffix, multi-digit frets, `h p / \ b r ~ x`, `(n)` ghost, `<n>` harmonic, `let ring`, varying dash widths |
| `bass-4-string.txt` | A 4-line (bass) staff: rejected as not playable |
